# Document Generation

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call <data>` {#draft-capital-call}

Draft capital call notice from sourced terms (review required)

Drafts a structured capital call notice with purpose breakdown, per-LP pro-rata table, recallable designation, default consequences, and wire instructions. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call` or asks to issue a capital call.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call <data>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-draft-capital-call <data>` |
| Codex | `$fund-draft-capital-call <data>` |

**Writes** `CAPITAL-CALL-[fund]-[number]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-capital-call/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-distribution <data>` {#draft-distribution}

Generate distribution notice with waterfall

Drafts a distribution notice with waterfall tier math, per-LP split by return of capital, preferred return and profit, tax withholding, and clawback reserve. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-distribution` or asks to issue a distribution.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund draft-distribution <data>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-draft-distribution <data>` |
| Codex | `$fund-draft-distribution <data>` |

**Writes** `DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-[fund]-[number]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-distribution/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-investor-letter <type>` {#draft-investor-letter}

Generate investor communications

Drafts LP communications: quarterly update, annual meeting notice, onboarding welcome, closing announcement, investment period extension, or wind-down notice. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-investor-letter <type>` or asks to write to LPs.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund draft-investor-letter <type>` |

**Writes** `INVESTOR-LETTER-[fund]-[type]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-investor-letter/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund draft-side-letter <terms>` {#draft-side-letter}

Generate side letter from provisions

Drafts an LP side letter from requested provisions (fee discount, MFN, co-invest, reporting, ERISA) with LPA section references and MFN cascade risk. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund draft-side-letter` or asks to draft a side letter for an LP.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund draft-side-letter <terms>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-draft-side-letter <terms>` |
| Codex | `$fund-draft-side-letter <terms>` |

**Writes** `SIDE-LETTER-[investor]-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-side-letter/SKILL.md)
